name: LOLIN C3 Mini
description: D1-mini-format ESP32-C3FH4 board (4 MB flash) with USB-C and a WS2812 RGB LED, compatible with the whole D1 mini shield ecosystem; 12 GPIOs for about $4.
notes: D1 mini shield compatible: 2x8 pins, rows 22.86 mm apart. Pin names (D0-D8, D10) are the LOLIN labels, not GPIO numbers; header data is taken from the official KiCad footprint/symbol.
Native USB Serial/JTAG only (no UART bridge): hold BOOT while plugging in to flash.
Header start offset (7.75 mm from the antenna end) is read from the KiCad footprint outline.
